backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of key frontend React and styling files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining CSS variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes with global styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that imports global styles and renders the LandingPage.
Animated aura background component with orb and particle effects that adapt to reduced-motion settings.
frontend/src/features/landing/LandingPag: Main landing page with aura visuals, branding, background assets, navigation, hero content, and sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing a backend actor tied to Internet Identity state using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, session loading, and login flows.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Hook detecting reduced-motion user preference via media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future backend-related React Query hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light/dark aura themes plus custom utility classes for glow, buttons, and cards.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom color variables, typography, container settings, animations, and aura-related color extensions.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, features, pending requests, and asset needs for the Aurise app.
